title: Production of syringic acid by direct CO2 insertion into syringol via a Kolbe–Schmitt type reaction

Syringic acid (4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxybenzoic acid) is a valuable hydroxybenzoic acid with applications in pharmaceuticals, food additives, and polymeric materials such as poly(phenylene oxide) (PPO).
